_comment: Community defaults for LLM prompts used in Evolve's analysis pipeline. Prompt overrides learned via audit feedback live in /Users/Shared/evolve/calibration/prompts.json. Each prompt entry includes the prompt text, a version string, and tracked performance statistics.

behavioral_test_judge._comment: Used by test_runner.py to judge whether a behavioral test passed. Overriding this prompt is how the RSI loop improves test judgment accuracy.

manifest_enrichment._comment: Used by reviewer.py when enriching a capability manifest with LLM-generated context.

forge_builder._comment: System prompt for the forge engine builder phase. Loaded by forge_engine.py to generate initial implementations and refinements. When null, the built-in prompt in forge_engine.py is used. The RSI loop can write an improved prompt here after observing high approval rates on variants.

forge_critic._comment: System prompt for the forge engine critic phase. Loaded by forge_engine.py for the critique cycle. When null, the built-in critic prompt is used. The RSI loop evolves this prompt based on whether critique rounds catch real problems (measured by operator-reported issues post-approval).
